g.text: Connects with .ovpn profiles from 19 VPN providers, without
their apps. UDP or TCP, automatic UDP → TCP fallback.
Fast modern tunnel from your .conf file. The program checks the
handshake, so you know the tunnel really works.
Uses Windows Firewall to block all traffic outside the VPN. If
the tunnel drops, your real IP never leaks.
Live ping for every server and one-click Smart Connect to the
fastest one. Tabs for P2P, streaming and gaming.
Sets Cloudflare, Quad9, AdGuard or OpenDNS for IPv4 and IPv6,
DNS leak test and WebRTC test: check that nothing gives away
SOCKS5 and HTTP proxy with login, a local bridge, and Firefox
launched through the proxy. 19 premium proxy providers.
Multi-threaded tester for proxy lists (.txt) with live results:
Encrypted tunnel that is hard to block, with ss:// link support
and a guide for your own server.
Downloads fresh server lists of NordVPN, PrivadoVPN, PIA,
Mullvad, AirVPN and others in one click.
Shows on the map which countries and nodes your traffic passes
Live download/upload charts, speedtest and how much data the
20 colour themes, Polish and English, works from the tray next
Ready entries for VPN Gate and IPSpeed public servers.
